posts.title: R Markdown and the DBA: charting average full database backup durations
posts.description: DBAs spend time dealing with SQL Server performance, capacity, monitoring, troubleshooting, provisioning, etcetera; I’ve previously mentioned that R is a powerful, open-source language with a great ecosystem of libraries for analysis and visualisation, so it’s no surprise that I think mixing SQL Server and R Markdown for reporting goes together like a Vegemite and cheese sandwich…lunch perfection!

posts.title: More improving inputs in Shiny & R Markdown
posts.description: In my last post on improving inputs in R Markdown/Shiny , I covered four improvements to quality of life in interactive reports and dashboards. In this blog post I have three more, all approaches I’ve used to add professionalism to self-service R Markdown files.
